mutations.name: RR-M1: the 'internal error occurred' TEXT arm reclaims an explicit invalid_argument (the reported 503)
RR-M2: the 4xx-class arm keeps the old UPSTREAM_INTERNAL verdict
RR-M3: drop the capability hint from the client message
mutations.anchor:
message: `${detail} [upstream rejected the request as invalid (${code}): the selected model `
        + 'may not support this input — e.g. an image on a model whose /v1/models row omits '
        + 'supports_images — or the message/tool shape is unsupported. Check supports_images in '
        + 'GET /v1/models and retry with a capable model or request shape]',

mutations.name: RR-M4: claim only invalid_argument and let failed_precondition pass through (#273.1 body)
RR-M5: re-admit a permanent rejection to the in-process retry loop
RR-M6: map the rejection back to the reported 503 UPSTREAM_INTERNAL surface
RR-M7: charge the account's error budget for a request rejection
RR-M8: stream the rejection as a retryable upstream_error
RR-M9: lose the rejection counter (silent in the connect metrics)
